desc: Ideation: operation reformulation, cost formula m = max(Δ+u, (D−Δ)+v), wall-parity feasibility rule, greedy grouping argument
Write brute-force BFS reference + prototype of conjectured formula/greedy (harness embedded in sol.py, runnable via `--validate`)
Core solver implementation for the real constraints (early exits: q > p, D < 0, D == 0 forcing u=v=0, q == 1 feasible; cheaper parity tried first)
Performance/IO engineering: `sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()`, numpy `frombuffer`+`flatnonzero(==49).tolist()`, tight two-pointer, `'\n'.join` output

Validation of the algorithm (no shell available to workers; performed as a full independent manager-side audit instead): re-derived cost formula (m = |Δ−v−w| + u+v+w = max(Δ+u, D−Δ+v)), confirmed u∈{0,1} suffices with v=(D−u) mod 2 and the `d>=1` guard, verified wall-parity necessity and the explicit block schedule's sufficiency (gap≥2 before interior ops, carry op at a shared occupied square, u-op at L / v-op at R), verified index-range safety (shape ops first, then one-directional translations), verified greedy pointer bounds (`lim = p-1`, `while/else`) and strict-increase of boundaries

Hand-traced verification of code paths on: all three samples (3 / −1 / 5, including the full length-20 two-pointer trace), `1101→0110`=1, `11→10`=1, `101→110`=1, `1001→0100`=2, `1010→0101`=1, `11011→10100`=3, `10100101→10101010`=2 (an earlier worker's claim of −1 here was wrong; the code's answer 2 is correct via ops i=8 then i=1), plus degenerate cases N=1, p=1, q=1, A=B, D=0, q>p, D<0
Complexity/limits check: O(ΣN) total (≤2 greedy passes of O(p)), byte-string handling (`c == 49` on bytes, `frombuffer` on bytes) correct for both the numpy and small-case paths
